title: Add recovery status summary
prompt: Add a small pure helper in src/ade/recovery_summary.py that summarizes a RecoveryRecord into a secret-free dictionary with task_id, failure, action, retry/repair/rebase/replan counts, and repeated_failures. If this task is dispatched again after CI failure, inspect the existing task branch/PR and repair that failing test or implementation so the same PR becomes green. Do not change .github, .autodev, GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, or pyproject.toml.
